from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CashBalanceReport(BaseModel):
    """One cash and cash equivalents balance record from a reporting period."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name in the report")
    report_year: str | None = Field(description="The calendar year of the report")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The specific period, e.g. '2018 年第三季度', '2019 年第一季度'")
    period_start_date: str | None = Field(description="Beginning date of the reporting period")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="Ending date of the reporting period")
    beginning_balance: float | None = Field(description="Cash and cash equivalents balance at the beginning of the period")
    ending_balance: float | None = Field(description="Cash and cash equivalents balance at the end of the period")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit, e.g. '元', '千元'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt from the report anchoring these figures")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cash_balance_reports: list[CashBalanceReport]
